name: Blood of the Swift: Like the Wind

system.description: Once per turn, when you deal wind or lightning damage to a creature, you can spend 1 Speed Seal, and select a different creature within 30 feet of you, and teleport into a space adjacent to them, and make one unarmed or weapon attack against them, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage], plus your spent Speed Seal.
